mechanics.name: The Void Dimension
mechanics.body: The Void Dimension is a space of existence that lies on top of the real world, invisible and untouchable for most beings. All objects and terrain is mirrored in shadow within the monochrome Void, creatures in the real world are represented as cloudy Shadow Remnants within this dimension. See the **Pierce the Veil** spell for more details.

mechanics.name: Fear
mechanics.body: A creature that is Feared against a enemy cannot willingly move towards the enemy while it has line of sight of the enemy, and it makes attack/spell attack rolls against the enemy with Disadvantage. Fear is a Weak Debuff.

mechanics.name: Paranoia
mechanics.body: A Paranoid creature does not act normally during their turn. They must use all **Actions** attacking or casting Spells against the closest creature, **including allies**. Paranoia is a *Strong Debuff*.

spells.name: Pierce The Veil
spells.body:
As a **Half Action** or **Extra Action** enter the Void dimension. This is a space of existence that lies on top of the real world, invisible and untouchable for most beings. All objects and terrain is mirrored in shadow within the monochrome Void, creatures in the real world are represented as cloudy Shadow Remnants within this dimension. While in the Void you can move freely, attack other Remnants and cast spells. Certain creatures and beings with special abilities or Truesight can see and target you while you’re in the Void.

When you cast Pierce the Veil to enter the Void, leave behind a **Void Remnant**, a shadowy figure in your shape, in the same position as you were in the real world. It has the same ACs, Resistances, etc. as you. **All damage the and effects the Remnant receives are inflicted to you.** This Remnant is **Resistant** to all **Non-magical** damage, but can only move when you command it to. Use a **Half** or **Extra Action** to make the Remnant move, take cover, etc. It has a base movement equal to yours and cannot exceed it. Enemies that you pull into the Void can make a **Full Action** **WIS** save to escape the Void, and typically leave behind their own Void Remnant which is also Resistant to Non-magical damage.

When you start your turn inside the Void, pay 2 Mana or be forcibly kicked out. Returning you to your where your current position would be in the real world. You may use a **Half** or **Extra Action** to leave the void for 0 Mana. Whenever you leave the Void, all Void Remnants of yours disappears and all enemies you pulled in come back into the real world.

Effects that reference “**Breach(ing) the Veil**” refer to when you when you use a spell, ability or attack from inside the Void to target outside in the real world, or **vice-versa**. When you *Breach the Veil* from within the Void, leave behind a temporary Void Remnant from your location into the real world until the end of your turn. These Remnants cannot overlap but you can make multiple of them. Enemies can react to the temporary Remnants.

upgrades.text: You can make your Void Remnant move with a Free Action, but every 2m it moves consumes 1m of your Movement. Its movement cannot exceed its base Movement.
Choose 4 Magical damage types, your Void Remnant is resistant to those types. You can change these damage types with a Short Rest Action.
You may spend **+1** additional Mana to start your turn in Stealth while you’re in the Void dimension.
Void Remnants left behind by enemies lose the Resistances granted by this spell.

spells.name: Blast From Beyond
spells.body:
As a *Full Action* call forth a beam of swirling entropic energy making a *Ranged Spell Attack* against a creature within *8m*, dealing *1d12* Entropic damage on hit. Damage increases by *+1d12* per 15 Void CA. Mana Cost increases by *+1* per 30 Void CA.

**0 Mana Cast:** As a Full Action the beam does **1d8** Entropic damage. Damage increases by +1d8 per 15 Void CA.

upgrades.text: Choose a point in space within *6m*, Blast From Beyond fires from that point targeting a creature within *8m* of it. Enemies do not consider you as the caster of this spell.
When you Breach the Veil with this spell, idk something happens.

spells.name: Enchant Weapon: Void
spells.body:
As a _Half Action_ enchant your weapon for your next **3** attacks/spell casts. Gain the following effects while enchanted depending on the weapon type:

**Melee**: Enchanted Melee attacks deal bonus Flat **Entropic** damage. **1d6** for Full Attacks, **1d4** for Half Attacks. Damage Dice Count increases by **+1** per 20 Void CA and every 3 Player Levels.

**Ranged**: Enchanted Ranged attacks deal bonus Flat **Entropic** damage. **1d6** for Full Attacks, **1d4** for Half Attacks. Damage Dice Count increases by **+1** per 20 Void CA and every 4 Player Levels.

**Spell Focus**: Enchanted spells that deal Entropic or Psychic damage gain **+2** to Attack rolls, increasing by **+1** per 20 Void CA and every 4 Player Levels. Enchanted spells that cause creatures to be **Feared** make those saves with **Disadvantage**.

upgrades.text: Enchanted Melee or Ranged attacks that **Breach the Veil** gain **+1** Dice Tier to the bonus damage. Enchanted spells that **Beach the Veil** increase their damage Dice Count by **+1**, and an additional **+1** per 20 Void CA. *+1 to Mana Cost*.

Enchanted Melee attacks deal an additional bonus Flat **Psychic** damage. **1d6** for Full Attacks, **1d4** for Half Attacks. Damage Dice Count increases by **+1** per 20 Void CA and every 3 Player Levels. *+1 Mana Cost*.

Enchanted Ranged attacks deal an additional bonus Flat **Psychic** damage. **1d6** for Full Attacks, **1d4** for Half Attacks. Damage Dice Count increases by **+1** per 20 Void CA and every 4 Player Levels. *+1 Mana Cost*.

When an Enchanted spell causes an enemy to become Feared, if that creature is already Feared by you, instead they make a **WIS** save becoming **Paranoid** for 1 turn on fail. If they pass the save, their Fear is extended by 1 turn instead.

spells.name: Grasp From the Depths
spells.body: As a **Full Action** conjure a large hand made with dark energies from the ground making a Melee Spell Attack against an enemy within 6m. The hand does **1d12** Entropic damage on hit, increasing by **+1d12** per 15 Void CA. Then the target must make a **AGI** save or become Immobilized for up to 10 turns, until you lose **Concentration**, or they break free. The Immobilized target can make an **AGI** or **STR** save to break free of the grasp using a *Half Action*. If the target is more than 1m off the ground, the spell misses.

upgrades.text: The hand extends into an arm and stretches up to another **6m** in any direction from the point its cast, if the hand successfully grabs a creature it pulls them down to the original cast point. This can target flying creatures.

If you **Breach the Veil** with this spell and they fail the AGI save, you have the creature swap dimensions, then they leave behind their own Void Remnant in the real world if you attacked from the Void

spells.name: The Void Stares Back
spells.body: As a **Half Action** target a creature within 12m feels the gaze of a thousand eyes from beyond. The target makes a WIS save or becomes **Feared** from you for 2 turns on fail. This spell always does **1d8** Entropic damage, but on the failed save it also deals **1d8** Psychic damage. Entropic damage increases by **+1d8** per 30 Void CA, and Psychic damage increases by **+1d8** per 15 Void CA (Psychic damage increases faster).

upgrades.text: You can cast this spell as a **Full Action** to make it an **AoE** spell targeting each enemies within a **6m** diameter of the point. *+2 Mana Cost.*

You may cast this spell as a **Full Action** which increases the Damage Dice Tier Dice Tier by **+1**. If you Breach the Veil with this cast the failed save inflicts **Paranoia** on the creature instead of Fear until the end of their next turn. This is an alternate cast and does not gain AoE from the other Upgrade.

spells.name: Void Gate
spells.body:
As a **Full Action** conjure two throbbing dark gates linking them together through twisted Void magic. Pick a empty spot within **3m**, and another within **15m** to create the gates. Each gate is a Void Object 1m in size, with **4d8** Health each rolled separately. Health increases by **+2d8** per 20 Void CA. They are Immune to Entropic and Psychic damage and Resistant to Non-Magical damage. If either of them are destroyed, both are destroyed and the spell ends. Both gates appear in the real world, and in the Void.

Any ranged attack or ranged spell from yourself or an ally has its range extended by the distance between the gates, i.e. if a 12m attack took 3m to get to the one gate, it has 9m of range left after leaving the other gate. A melee attack from yourself or an ally from one gate can target any creature adjacent to the other gate.

upgrades.text: You, your Remnant, or an ally can spend **1 Mana** and **2m** of movement to enter one gate and exit anywhere adjacent to the other gate. Any creature that can **Pierce the Veil** can choose exit out of the Void through the second gate, or into the real world if they started in the Void. Enemies can cross through gate using a *Full Action*, but they take **1d12** Entropic damage doing so and can only exit into the same dimension. *+2 to Mana cost.*

Your attacks and spells can Breach the Veil through a gate, targeting or affecting enemies crossing dimensions. Attacks or spells that do so gain **+1** to damage **Dice Tier**, however the initial gate your are attacking/casting through takes Flat **1d8** Pure damage.

signatureSpells.name: Watchful Eye
signatureSpells.body:
As a **Full Action** target yourself or an ally within **8m**, protecting them with a watchful eye of the Void. Watchful Eye is a *Strong Buff* that lasts for 3 rounds. This spell costs **-2 Mana** if you target yourself. If a creature with Watchful Eye becomes the target of a spell or is attacked, they can make a **Reaction** to *Pierce the Veil* and enter the Void dimension, leaving behind a **Void Remnant** of their own. The attack or spell is then made against the Remnant instead of the initial target. Watchful Eye continues to last even it’s triggered right away and protected target immediately returns to the real world.

If they don’t have a Void Crystal, they don’t gain up the upgrades you have regarding the Void. However their Remnant gains the basic abilities like being able to move with Half or Extra Actions, and gaining **Resistances** to all Non-Magical damage types, following the same rules as your un-upgraded ones. Allies in the Void can Breach the Veil and make attacks, leaving behind temporary Remnants like you. At the start of an allies turn inside the Void, they must pay **3 Mana** or be forcefully exited. If Watchful Eye’s duration ends at the end of an ally’s turn, they are also forcefully removed.

upgrades.text: Choose 4 Magical damage types, Remnants created by Watchful Eye are Resistant to these damage types.

As a **Free Reaction** when Watchful Eye triggers on an ally before the attack hits their Remnant, you can have your Remnant and that ally's’ swap places in the real world. You may also instead choose to swap places with that ally within the Void. Either of these swaps can also be done with an Extra Action.
